title: RSS and Atom Snapshot Normalizer and Delta JSON

publicDataOnly.title: Public non-personal permitted input only
publicDataOnly.description: Keep checked to confirm the documents are public, permitted to process, and contain no personal data. Runs with this unchecked are rejected (not charged). This is a policy acknowledgement, not automated PII detection.

feedUrls.title: Feed URLs
feedUrls.description: Public RSS 2.0 or Atom feed URLs (up to 5 in total together with pasted documents). Each feed is fetched by the Actor: at most 1 MiB (gzip accepted, decompressed size also capped), ports 80/443 only, no credentials in the URL, redirects limited to 3, 20-second timeout; URLs resolving to private/internal addresses are refused. Failed fetches are listed in the run summary and are not charged.

knownIds.title: Known IDs (applies to all feed URLs)
knownIds.description: Entry IDs you have already seen (up to 5,000). Entries with these IDs get isNew=false in every fetched feed. Pasted documents carry their own knownIds.

documents.title: Pasted documents (optional, up to 5 in total with URLs)
documents.description: Optional. Content you paste directly. Counts toward the 1-5 items per run together with the URL list. 1 MiB XML, 500 input entries, knownIds up to 5,000 strings. RSS 2.0/Atom only. Each entry requires a valid absolute HTTP(S) link. No RDF/RSS 1.0, relative-link resolution, XML entities or DTDs. No article fetching, author data, full descriptions, emails or contacts. Titles and publication dates stay as provided, not inferred. Pricing: $0.003 per successful document + $0.00005/run start. XML entries/PDF chunks are nested, not separately charged. Total input under 8 MB.
